Added `specs/minds-evals-atif-transcripts/spec.md`: a design spec that makes the ATIF trajectory document the only transcript a minds_evals trial hands to grading, sourced from mngr's common transcript whenever the workspace can provide it.

The spec records why grading reads `trajectory.json` alone (parity with every other harbor eval, which has no rendered feed), where the capture runs (an always-on step of the evidence-collection phase, while the workspace is still alive), why the workspace builds the ATIF document itself (`mngr transcript --format atif`), how the driver keeps a hand-built document in the box after every turn and replaces it with the workspace's once captured, how `final_metrics` and an `extra.minds_evals` provenance block are reconciled onto it, what each verifier script reads, the trial metadata (`trajectory_source`, `transcript_capture`), and the per-failure fallbacks to the hand-built document. No change to `libs/mngr`.

Also added `specs/minds-evals-worker-trajectories/spec.md` (implemented in the same PR): a design for capturing the background workers a workspace agent launches through the launch-task skill (discovered from the launch commands in its own stream, captured per worker with `mngr transcript`, pulled as a `verification/workers/` directory, and embedded in `trajectory.json` under the launching call as `subagent_kind: "mngr"` with an `extra.worker` block), with their tokens folded into the trial's transcript usage account.
